title: scurrula parasitica var. graciliflora
intro: Scurrula parasitica var. graciliflora, commonly known as the "Indian poison tree," is a parasitic plant species belonging to the family Santalaceae. This plant is known for its traditional medicinal uses, particularly in treating various health issues such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The health benefits of Scurrula parasitica var. graciliflora include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in treating infections and reducing inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
